prompt:
Create a NEW illustration in EXACTLY the visual style of the reference images.
STRICT STYLE: warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults. Warm cream ground (#EFE6D2/#F5F1E9), muted blue fills (#8FB0CE), soft dark line (#3B382F).

Subject: THREE-PANEL HORIZONTAL STRIP, three equal panels in a row separated by clean cream gutters, no drawn borders or frame lines. ONE consistent world, ONE consistent glowing translucent amber laptop, ONE consistent person across all three panels. The figure is a woman in her forties, Black, short natural hair, wearing a plain rust-colored knit sweater over a grey collared shirt; the SAME woman appears in all three panels and must be recognizably the same person in each.

BEAT ONE (left panel): She sits at a warm wooden table beside the glowing translucent amber laptop, speaking three small amber word-shapes toward it. Inside the laptop screen a single small agent figure catches them and hands back one modest finished item: a single sheet of paper resting on the table beside her. The sheet is completely BLANK with no lettering. What came out is small.

BEAT TWO (middle panel): Same table, same woman, same laptop, same three small amber word-shapes leaving her mouth, no more than before. Inside the screen a rounded agent figure in a gold military cap leans forward holding up two small BLANK cards toward her, and she raises two fingers in answer. Out of the laptop spills something far larger than the sheet in beat one: a fully set banquet table with chairs and dressed places, an entire organized event, overflowing onto the floor beside her.

BEAT THREE (right panel): Same world, wider view. A fresh chalk line is drawn across the wooden floor, and a fainter older chalk line lies well behind it, showing the line has been redrawn further out. The banquet from beat two now stands finished on the near side of the new line. Just past the new line, on the far side, stands a complete wedding arch dressed in flowers with an aisle of empty chairs, waiting and not yet reached. The woman stands at the new line with the glowing laptop under her arm, looking across at it.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

no comic-book, no cartoon mascot, no flat vector, no neon, no 3D/CGI/Pixar, no photoreal, no anime, no identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.

Render each of these strings EXACTLY, in this placement, in the cream margins only and never over the artwork: title bar in caps centered above the three panels: "THE OUTCOME FRONTIER"; caption in the cream gutter directly under the left panel: "A FEW WORDS. ONE PAGE."; caption in the cream gutter directly under the middle panel: "SAME WORDS. TWO ANSWERS. FAR MORE BACK."; caption in the cream gutter directly under the right panel: "THE LINE MOVED. THE NEXT THING WAITS."; footer bar in caps centered below the panels: "SAME WORDS IN. MORE OUT EVERY YEAR." No other text anywhere. Every card, sheet, label and the wedding arch carries NO lettering at all.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
